lines.en: : Ahem.
: Imani?...
: What are you doing in my bed?...
: This is my bed. And you appear to be naked in it.
: Oh...yeah. Weird. Shouldn’t you be naked too then? I don’t think it’s normal for only one person to be like that.
: Then why don’t you turn around and see who else is here?
: What? But- OH MY GOD!
: Shhh! You’re gonna wake him up!
: That wasn’t a sex dream?! Did me and Akira actually...
: Do you have sex dreams about him often?
: Yes. Is that not normal?
: Oh, right. I should probably be apologizing.
: But, in my defense, I must have been very drunk. Because all I can remember is coming up with a plan to make him confess to wanting to bone Rin.
: Weird ending to that plan, I’ve gotta say.
: Are you mad at me? What if you were involved? What do you remember? Maybe we did it and just made him watch. You don’t know that’s what didn’t happen.
: I do actually. Because you had the bright idea of sending me a text before passing out that said, “Sorry sex Akira. So dizzy. Huge dick. Good sex. Drunk. Sex good. Love you.”
: Well, at least I said I love you. That means I’m forgiven, right?
: There’s nothing to forgive you for if you want to get technical about it. It’s not like we’re official or anything.
: Plus, you’re an idiot when you’re not drunk. I can’t expect you to act rationally when you are. Just maybe not in my bed next time, please?
: Sure, yeah. I honestly don’t even understand how it happened. I’ve been so good at not having sex with people lately that I felt like I was about to go pro at it.
: Well, on the bright side, we’ve got one more thing in common now. Just sucks that we’re going to have to be competing over it.
: Competing? What? No way. He’s yours. Just because we hooked up while we were both hammered doesn’t mean I’m going to try and steal him away from you.
: Was he drunk too? I don’t remember.
: He had to be, right? There’s no way our plan would fail that badly. Like...did we get him to confess? Do we know the truth now?
: I was really hoping you would. All I remember is throwing up on his lap.
: And I still had sex with him? What the hell is wrong with me?
: Hey, I get it. I was in the same boat as you not so long ago.
: Sure...and while I do feel like the madness bubbling up within me has slowed down a little, I still feel like coming out of this without an answer isn’t really useful.
: What are you suggesting then? We get him drunk again?
: Oooh! Good idea! We just film it this time!
: Rika-
: And then watch the tape together if we both pass out again! I haven’t been naked on film since I was your age! I’m curious!
: Rika, I was joking. Getting him drunk didn’t work the first time and we’re still no closer to knowing the truth. Why don’t we just ask him if we really want to know?
: I did, remember? And he flat out denied it and told me he’d get Rin to back off.
: Well, I imagine that’ll be a lot easier once she finds out you slept with him.
: I don’t want her to know that! Even if it gets her to think I’m punk again! She’s already had her heart broken a million times!
: Hasn’t it only been, like...two?
: That’s like a million in teenager years! Weren’t you ever a kid?!
: Rika...just let me talk to him, okay? Senpai’s not going to respond to tricks. Unless he...literally did already and we just can’t remember it because we got too drunk.
: Unless you have a better idea, that is.
: Not really. My head’s still fucked up from drinking so much. And my entire lower body feels kind of numb for some reason.
: Yeah. You’ll get used to that.
: What’s the plan now then? Just...talk? You guys? Alone? While I wait in the corner and pretend to also be important?
: I want this headache to go away before having a discussion like that. I think last night was the first time I’ve ever blacked out. At least...due to alcohol and not traumatic physical abuse.
: Oh! That! Traumatic physical abuse! That’s how we can get him to confess!
: Kwesi? That you in there? Get out of my friend’s head.
: Imani, what does Akira hate more than anything?
: I honestly don’t even know where to begin.
: Hard work! We’ve just gotta team up and push his hunky body past its physical limits! Consensually, of course.
: Like...like a threesome?
: No. Something even better.
: This!
: So, I get what you’re going for and do think this will be more effective in the long run. But I question exactly why you would call this “better.”
: Easy! I lied! I just didn’t want last night affecting my morning routine since missing one gym day inevitably leads to missing all of them!
: Why am I here?
: In fact, who am I? I consumed so much alcohol last night that I believe I may have amnesia.
: You fucker. You remember everything, don’t you?
: Nope. Just that you owe me a new pair of pants.
: I may have started it, sure. But this is really on Rika for not knowing how to use a washing machine.
: I got help this time!
: Yeah! From me!
: I’m just glad the gym has a coin laundry in it.
: And also that the front door was unlocked. I actually don’t think we’re supposed to be here right now.
: Yeah, you’re definitely not.
: Ahh! Cancer!
: Yes, hello. It is me. Cancer.
: I mean Yuki! Pretty woman! You are here!
: I didn’t realize you were still coming. I hadn’t seen you since we came together.
: Because I wasn’t. It’s just an excuse to get me out of the damn manor. Didn’t think Tsubasa would flat out buy the gym to keep an eye on me, though.
: Tsubasa...so that is the name of my arch nemesis. I’ll just have to buy a bigger gym.
: You and what income?
: How are you feeling, Yuki? Any better?
: Pretty good, all things considered. You should drop by more often. Easier to give you updates that way.
: You could always just text me, you know.
: I could. Can’t see your face that way, though.
: Okay! My turn for attention!
: I’m gonna go catch up with Yuki and see if I’m still allowed to come here after today! I’ll meet back up with you guys in a minute!
: But I-
: I want updates too! We’re gym buddies, remember?! I care! Probably too much. But that just means I need to know!
: Hah...I guess it can’t be helped. Come on. I already scouted out the blind spots where I can sneak a cig without being noticed.
: Oh, not on my watch. Yoink!
: Hey! Give those back!

Rika and Yuki exit the gym together just a mere five minutes after we arrive, leaving me alone with Imani in what I’m sure will momentarily dissolve into a mildly heartfelt conversation about drinking responsibly.
: Hah...
: So, how was it?
: How was what?
: Don’t play dumb, Senpai. I know you had sex with Rika.
: Did the fact that we were both naked when you woke up give that away?
: That and her not so subtle text about the size of your penis and how good sex is.
: That family has a problem when it comes to texting things they shouldn’t.
: So, how much did you wind up telling us before we both got completely smashed?
: Nothing really. But that was mostly due to the fact that you guys were drunk before I even figured out what was going on and not because I was trying to keep anything secret.
: You’ll be honest now then? Since we’re both completely sober?
: Honest about what? I am an oblivious, stupid man who lacks the ability to pick up on social and contextual clues.
: You know, silence can be really deafening in certain contexts, Senpai. I’d almost prefer you just lie to me at this point.
: And what would lying accomplish exactly?
: What does hiding something from your best friend accomplish?
: Are you not hiding anything from me?
: Not anymore. I told you why I look the way I do and that was the only thing I was actively keeping from you. And even then, it was just because I felt ashamed.
: You’re not the only one who feels shame. And you were certainly hiding something from me last night too.
: I never expected Rika’s plan to work, honestly. It just seemed like the easiest way to confront you about a topic that isn’t really easy to broach.
: And I imagine it’s one you’ve wanted to broach for a while now, huh?
: Be straight with me, Senpai. How far has it gone?
: Imani-
: Like, have you actually done anything? Or is this just some sort of Pied Piper situation where you extract some sort of personal value from leading on an entire class of girls who like you?
: I like you, Imani. Am I leading you on too?
: Not necessarily. You just seemed to like me a lot more when I was cosplaying as a schoolgirl.
: But it was your idea to do that, so you clearly understand the appeal.
: Of course I understand the appeal. This is fucking Japan, yo. The appeal is everywhere. The sexualization is everywhere. And we all participate in it whether we like it or not.
: And I’m not saying that’s right — just a lot more morally ambiguous than getting lost in the sauce and crossing lines you’re smart enough to know you shouldn’t.
: And don’t go stalling for time while you wait for Rika to get rejected again. Just talk to me.
: I don’t know how much you remember from last night, but I tried to.
: Well, why’d you stop? That could have been a breakthrough.
: I stopped because that’s when you threw up all over my pants.
: Oh.
: Well, yeah...I guess that would do it. But you can tell me now then, right? As a friend. Not a coworker.
: It’s not just as a friend either though since I’ve made it apparent you’re more to me than that.
: I’m happy to hear that, obviously...But there’s a time and a place for flattery and this is certainly not it.
: Those girls are like daughters to me, in a way. Like yeah, they’re annoying as fuck sometimes. But they’ve made me a better person, weirdly enough.
: That’s why I’m always trying to go above and beyond for them. And I’m sure there’s an argument to be made about how teachers should just always do that, but...I don’t know.
: Maybe it’s just because they’re the first class I’ve ever been with full-time...but they really do feel more like family than students to me at this point.
: Just this family is far more accepting than the one I had. So I’ve got this primal urge to just...protect them.
: And you’re worried you have to protect them from me.
: I’m thinking of them like little kids at a zoo and you as a lion who escaped its cage.
: You’re cute and fluffy and they all want to pet you, but you could snap at any moment and completely annihilate them. That’s what I want to avoid.
: Do you think I don’t care about them then, Imani?
: No, I know you do. That’s why I never felt the need to bring this up and always just told myself I was being ridiculous.
: But it’s gotten a lot more real lately. And if Rika is starting to worry about her actual daughter as a result of it, I shouldn’t just ignore it any longer.
: I never should have to begin with. I should have cleared this up the moment I first heard anything inappropriate. But I wanted them to like me and I wanted to be cool.
: I wanted you to like me too.
: I like being liked, Senpai. I don’t want to be the bad guy.
: Neither do I. I just...I don’t know.
: What’s there to not know? Either you’ve crossed a line or you haven’t. There’s no nuance here. It’s just yes or no.
: There is nuance, though. I just can’t really address it without sounding like either a psychopath or someone who doesn’t take your concerns seriously. Which I do. It’s just...complicated.
: Because of what happened to you when you were young?
: Well...no? That’s not exactly what I had in mind. It definitely doesn’t help, though.
: What then? Help me understand how you’re a victim here too. Because I’d love nothing more than to be able to believe that, Senpai.
: I’ll just...okay. Imagine time stopped moving. And you stayed the way you are now for the rest of forever.
: Would you just keep looking at everyone younger than you as children for the rest of eternity? Even if they were still growing mentally?
: That’s...a question alright. I don’t know. Probably not? That’s not how this works, though.
: Time is moving. And in a few years, most of these girls are going to be going off to college and really starting their lives. It’s just our job to make sure they survive high school.
: Yeah, well...I agree with that. And I can promise you that, no matter what happens, that much isn’t going to change.
: And if you want any proof of that, just look at how I don’t come to school anymore. That’s for their benefit mostly. I just also happen to profit off it in a sense.
: Sure do. Still collecting a paycheck despite doing literally nothing at 31 is a life most people wouldn’t even dream of, Senpai. Yet you’re out here thriving.
: “Thriving” is a bit too generous, Imani. Not a day goes by where I don’t contemplate throwing myself off a building.
: I wonder what this world would be like if everyone was as good at playing the victim as you.
: Probably horrible. But it’s not like it’s that great in the first place, so...
: It’s not that bad. Depressing and tempting, sure. But I think there’s enough good stuff out there to offset all the misery. Really comes down to what you surround yourself with.
: Then that’s probably why you’re so happy and I’m so...nothing.
: Keep me close and just leech off my energy then. Or Rika’s, I guess...since that’s a thing now.
: Right. Yes. But before you think I took advantage of her-
: She totally started it. I know.
: Good. Now we can begin the moral debate on which is more acceptable to hook up with — a dangerously inebriated MILF or a completely sober, mentally mature high-schooler.
: The trick is to just hook-up with your best friend and avoid both of those things completely.
: That’s the one I want the most right now, for sure. That smile kills me every time.
: Again, there’s a time and a place for flattery, Senpai. And I politely ask that you abstain from saying things that make me like you more until I find out how fucked up you really are.
: Put the schoolgirl outfit back on and we can find out together.
: You’re sick. What do you want to drink?
: Some cyanide, maybe?
: How about some water? Rika’s planning on “pushing you past your physical limits” today and I don’t want you getting dehydrated before you can confess to your sins.
: Works for me. And...Imani?
: Yeah?
: I think it’s okay to stop covering up so much during times like this. You’ll overheat working out in that.
: Different conversation, Senpai. But thank you.
: I’ll think about it.
Imani pulls herself off the bench and heads to the door, leaving me alone with an array of workout machines I don’t know how to operate.
As such, I simply pace around the room and increase my step count for the day.
I have now sufficiently exercised and can return to figuring out whether or not it’s safe to tell Imani that I am, in fact, the scum of the earth.
Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
